Project Lantern is a made-up offline-first note-taking app that exists only as fixture
data for testing this tool.

**Why:** It gives the test suite a small "project" node with real-looking prose,
without describing any real software.

**How to apply:** Treat every detail here as invented. It links to a fictional parts
list at [[reference-radio-parts]] and to [[ghost-roadmap-notes]], a slug that is never
defined anywhere in this fixture set, to exercise ghost-node handling.
